title: Grateful Dead Live at Onondaga County War Memorial on 1981-05-17
source: Source Info: Frank Streeter's Master FOB Audience Cassette; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5M (TDK MA90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz)> KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition 3.0> TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy return show with an enthusiastic Dead.
ai_review.review: The recording comes straight from Frank’s deck and remains as crispy as fans remember, delivering excellent clarity. The band sounded psyched to be back after a long hiatus, feeding the set with palpable excitement and a solid set list. Overall it’s a very enjoyable listening experience both musically and technically.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review praises both the performance (enthusiastic return, great set) and the soundboard quality (crispy, clear). With limited data confidence is low but the combined show and recording assessment warrants a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix directly from Frank's deck; no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and enthusiastic return performance with a well‑received set list.
